spans.s: (or विड्) = बिट्, Dhātup. ix, 30 (v.l.)

1. विड् (cf. √ बिट् and विट्; prob. artificial and of doubtful connection with the following words) cl. 1. P. वेडति, to call, cry out, curse, swear, Dhātup. ix, 30 v.l.;
to break, W.
2. विड् f. a bit, fragment, W.
in comp. for 3. विष्.

(accord. to some connected with √ विष्), only Caus. वीड॑यति, or वीळयति, ˚ते, (P.) to make strong or firm, strengthen, fasten, RV. viii, 45, 6;
 (Ā.) to be strong or firm or hard, ib. ii, 37, 3 &c.

n. a kind of salt (either factitious salt, procured by boiling earth impregnated with saline particles, or a partic. kind of fetid salt used medicinally as a tonic aperient, commonly called Vit-lavan or Bit-noben, cf. विड्-लवण; it is black in colour and is prepared by fusing fossil silt with a small portion of Emblic Myrobalan, the product being muriate of soda with small quantities of muriate of lime, sulphur, and oxide of iron), Suśr.
N. of a country and its king, Inscr.
a fragment, bit, portion (?), W.
bone, L.
विड—गन्ध n. the medicinal salt described above, W.
विड—लवण m. n. id., MBh.; Bhpr.
clever, able, skilful, L.
and f(आ). Embelia Ribes, L.
the fruit of the above plant (a vermifuge), L.
वि-˚डम्ब mfn. imitating, representing, BhP.
वि-˚डम्ब m. mockery, derision, Kāv.; Sāh.
degradation, desecration, VarBṛS.
afflicting, distressing, annoyance, MW.
वि-˚डम्बक mfn. imitating, strikingly resembling, Kād.
disgracing, profaning, Kāv.; BhP.
वि-˚डम्बन mfn. imitating, representing, acting like, BhP.

वि-˚डम्बन n. and f(आ). imitation, copying, representing, playing the part of any one, imposture, disguise (esp. applied to a god assuming human form), Kāv.; Pur. (acc. with √ कृ, to imitate, copy, represent)
वि-˚डम्बन n. derision, ridiculousness, mockery, scoff, scorn, vexation, mortification, MBh.; Kāv. &c. (acc. with √ कृ, to mock, deride)
disgrace, degradation, profanation, BhP.
abuse, misusage, VarBṛS.
disappointing, frustrating, MW.
वि-˚डम्बनीय mfn. to be imitated &c.
to be distressed or annoyed, MW.
वि-˚डम्बित mfn. imitated, copied &c.
disguised, transformed, distorted, Hariv.
vexed, mortified, W.
low, poor, abject, ib.
deceived, disappointed, frustrated, MW.
वि-˚डम्बित n. an object of ridicule or contempt, despicable object, ib.
वि-˚डम्बि˚तेश्वर mfn. imitating or representing Śiva, Ragh.
वि-˚डम्बिन् mfn. imitating, copying, bearing a striking resemblance, Uttarar.; Kād.
mocking, deriding, vying with, surpassing, Śiś.; Kāvyād.
disgracing, degrading, profaning, VarBṛS.
causing deception or error, MW.
वि-˚डम्ब्य n. an object of ridicule or contempt, BhP.
See under 2. विश्.
विडाल. See बिड्˚.
(also written विळि-न्˚) N. of an author, Cat.
the act of flying aslant or obliquely (one of the different modes of flight attributed to birds; others being अव-, उड्-, नि-, परि-, प्र-, सं-डीन, and डीन-डीनक, q.v.), MBh.
flying apart, ib.
विडु, विडुल, w.r. for विद्˚.

or वीळु॑, mf(˚ड्वी)n. strong, firm, hard, RV.; VS.;
 n. anything firmly fixed or strong, stronghold, RV.
विडु, विडुल, w.r. for विद्˚.
for वि-दूर-ज, p. 966, col. 1. (Cf. वैडुर्य.)
or विड्-औजस् m. (also written बिड्˚; said to be fr. विड् = 2. विश् + ओजस्) N. of Indra, Kālid.; Śatr. (in BhP. viii, 5, 41 as two words, meaning ‘the Vaiśya and his trade’).
or विड्-औजस् m. (also written बिड्˚; said to be fr. विड् = 2. विश् + ओजस्) N. of Indra, Kālid.; Śatr. (in BhP. viii, 5, 41 as two words, meaning ‘the Vaiśya and his trade’).
विड्-ग्रह &c. See under 3. विष्.
विड्—गन्ध n. = -लवण, L.
विड्ड—सिंह m. N. of a man, Rājat.
विड्—ग्रह m. stoppage or obstruction of the feces, constipation, Bhpr.
विड्—घात m. a partic. urinary disease, Car.
विड्—ज mfn. produced from ordure, Yājñ.
विड्—ज n. a fungus, W.
विड्—बन्ध m. constipation, Suśr.
विड्—भङ्ग m. diarrhoea, ib.
विड्—भव mfn. = -ज, W.
विड्—भिद् f. = -भङ्ग, Bhpr.
विड्—भुज् mfn. feeding on ordure, Mn. xii, 56
विड्—भुज् m. a dung-beetle or a similar insect, BhP.
विड्—भेद m. = -भङ्ग, Car.
विड्—भेदिन् mfn. laxative, Suśr.
विड्—भेदिन् n. (prob.) = -लवण, L.
विड्—भोजिन् mfn. = -भुज्, Pañcar.
विड्—लवण n. a medicinal salt (commonly called Vitlaban or Bitnoben), L.
विड्—वराह m. a tame or village hog, BhP.
विड्—विघात m. = -घात, Car.
or वी॑ळित, mfn. made strong, strengthened, firm, hard, RV.
वीडु॑—जम्भ (वीडु॑-), mfn. strong-jawed, RV.
वीडु—द्वे॑षस् mfn. hating the strong or hating strongly, ib.
वीडु—प॑त्मन् mfn. flying strongly or incessantly, ib.
वीडु—पवि॑ mfn. having strong tires (as the Maruts), ib.
वीडु॑—पाणि॑ (or वीडु॑-प्˚) mfn. strong-handed, strong-hoofed, ib.
वीडु॑—हरस् (वीडु॑-), mfn. seizing firmly, holding fast, ib.
वीडु—हर्षि॑न् mfn. (prob.) fiercely passionate, refractory, ib.
वीड्व्-अ᳙ङ्ग mfn. strong-limbed, firm in body, ib.
